content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I would like to propose a small adjustment to the relevant clause. - Regarding the payment terms, payment is delayed for 90 days, which creates cash flow pressure for my business, so I propose changing this so that invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you and I look forward to your reply.
